theorem etcdstart.Cur_zero : etcdstart.Cur 0 (W64 0)

def etcdstart.wev : Type :=
  github_com.mit_pdos.etcd_grove.examples.lib.etcdstart.Event

def etcdstart.CheckOk (evs : List etcdstart.wev) (tried : List etcdstart.wkv) (oks : List
    etcdstart.wrec) : Prop :=
  evs.length + 1 < 2 ^ 63 ∧
    (∀ (i : Nat) (e : etcdstart.wev),
        evs[i]? = some e → e.Put' = true ∧ sint.Z e.Rev' = 2 + ↑i ∧ (e.Key', e.Val') ∈ List.map etcdstart.pairOf tried) ∧
      ∀ (p : etcdstart.wrec),
        p ∈ oks → 2 ≤ sint.Z p.Rev' ∧ ∃ e, evs[(sint.Z p.Rev' - 2).toNat]? = some e ∧ e.Key' = p.Key' ∧ e.Val' = p.Val'

theorem etcdstart.revAt_persistent (E : apply.AEnv GF) (r : Nat) (k v : GoString) : Persistent
    (etcdstart.revAt E r k v)

def etcdstart.GenKv (keys : List GoString) (p : etcdstart.wkv) : Prop :=
  p.Key' ∈ keys ∧ p.Val' ∈ etcdstart.genVals

def etcdstart.revAt (E : apply.AEnv GF) (r : Nat) (k v : GoString) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ L, mvcc.idxSealed E.γ.idx L ∗ ⌜L[r]? = some [mvcc.Change.put k v (W64 0)]⌝)

def etcdstart.collectOk (R : Nat → GoString → GoString → IProp GF) (P : List (GoString × GoString))
    (upTo : w64) (evs : List etcdstart.wev) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜(upTo = W64 0 ∨ sint.Z upTo ≤ 1 + ↑evs.length) ∧
          evs.length + 1 < 2 ^ 63 ∧
            ∀ (i : Nat) (e : etcdstart.wev),
              evs[i]? = some e → e.Put' = true ∧ sint.Z e.Rev' = 2 + ↑i ∧ (e.Key', e.Val') ∈ P⌝ ∗
      □ ∀ i e, ⌜evs[i]? = some e⌝ -∗ R (2 + i) e.Key' e.Val')

def etcdstart.evWev (e : EvModel) (v : GoString) : etcdstart.wev :=
  { Rev' := e.rev, Key' := e.key, Val' := v, Put' := decide (e.typ = W32 0) }

def etcdstart.CollectFacts (P : List (GoString × GoString)) (upTo : w64) (evs : List etcdstart.wev)
    : Prop :=
  (upTo = W64 0 ∨ sint.Z upTo ≤ 1 + ↑evs.length) ∧
    evs.length + 1 < 2 ^ 63 ∧
      ∀ (i : Nat) (e : etcdstart.wev), evs[i]? = some e → e.Put' = true ∧ sint.Z e.Rev' = 2 + ↑i ∧ (e.Key', e.Val') ∈ P

theorem etcdstart.wp_etcdWatch_receive [go_etcd_io.etcd.cache.v3.Assumptions] [EM : EtcdModel GF]
    (ch : Loc) (γ : EtcdWatchNames) (pfx : GoString) (n : Nat) (cursor : w64) : ⊢ ∀ Φ,
    isEtcdWatchChan ch γ pfx ∗ etcdWatchConsumer γ n cursor -∗ (▷ ∀ v ok, (if ok = true then |==> ∃
    r c', respAt v r ∗ watchRespOk pfx cursor c' v r ∗ etcdWatchConsumer γ (n + 1) c' else ⌜v =
    zero_val go_etcd_io.etcd.client.v3.WatchResponse⌝) -∗ Φ (intoVal v, intoVal ok)) -∗ WP
    ((chan.receive go_etcd_io.etcd.client.v3.WatchResponse.ty) (intoVal ch)) {{ Φ }}

def etcdstart.Cur (n : Nat) (c : w64) : Prop :=
  n = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ sint.Z c ∧ sint.Z c ≤ 1 ∨ 1 ≤ n ∧ sint.Z c = 1 + ↑n

def etcdstart.wkv : Type :=
  github_com.mit_pdos.etcd_grove.examples.lib.etcdstart.KV

def etcdstart.evFactR (R : Nat → GoString → GoString → IProp GF) (P : List (GoString × GoString)) (r
    : Nat) (e : EvModel) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜e.typ = W32 0 ∧ sint.Z e.rev = ↑r⌝ ∗ ∃ v kvv, kvValAt e.kv kvv ∗ ⌜kvv.value = v ∧ (e.key, v) ∈ P⌝ ∗ R r e.key v)

theorem etcdstart.watchRespOk_closeErr' [go_etcd_io.etcd.cache.v3.Assumptions] [EM : EtcdModel GF]
    (pfx : GoString) (k k' : w64) (v : go_etcd_io.etcd.client.v3.WatchResponse) (r : RespModel) :
    watchRespOk pfx k k' v r ⊢ go_etcd_io.etcd.cache.v3.statusErrOk v.closeErr'

theorem etcdstart.collectOk_intro (R : Nat → GoString → GoString → IProp GF) (P : List (GoString ×
    GoString)) (upTo : w64) (evs : List etcdstart.wev) (h : etcdstart.CollectFacts P upTo evs) : (□
    ∀ i e, ⌜evs[i]? = some e⌝ -∗ R (2 + i) e.Key' e.Val') ⊢ etcdstart.collectOk R P upTo evs

theorem etcdstart.GenKv.sizeOk {keys : List GoString} {p : etcdstart.wkv} (hk : ∀ (k : GoString), k
    ∈ keys → List.length k ≤ 2 ^ 28) (h : etcdstart.GenKv keys p) : etcdstart.wkvSizeOk p

def etcdstart.wkvSizeOk (p : etcdstart.wkv) : Prop :=
  List.length p.Key' ≤ 2 ^ 28 ∧ List.length p.Val' ≤ 2 ^ 28

theorem etcdstart.revAt_agree [mvcc_sem : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.Assumptions] (E :
    apply.AEnv GF) (r : Nat) (k v k' v' : GoString) : etcdstart.revAt E r k v ∗ etcdstart.revAt E r
    k' v' ⊢ ⌜k = k' ∧ v = v'⌝

theorem etcdstart.collectOk_elim (R : Nat → GoString → GoString → IProp GF) (P : List (GoString ×
    GoString)) (upTo : w64) (evs : List etcdstart.wev) : etcdstart.collectOk R P upTo evs ⊢
    ⌜etcdstart.CollectFacts P upTo evs⌝ ∗ □ ∀ i e, ⌜evs[i]? = some e⌝ -∗ R (2 + i) e.Key' e.Val'

theorem etcdstart.wkvSizeOk.put {p : etcdstart.wkv} (h : etcdstart.wkvSizeOk p) : opSizeOk
    (opPutModel p.Key' p.Val' [])

def etcdstart.pairOf (p : etcdstart.wkv) : GoString × GoString :=
  (p.Key', p.Val')

def etcdstart.wrec : Type :=
  github_com.mit_pdos.etcd_grove.examples.lib.etcdstart.PutRec

def etcdstart.genVals : List GoString :=
  [go!"a", go!"b", go!"c", go!"d"]

theorem etcdstart.evFactR_intro {R : Nat → GoString → GoString → IProp GF} {P : List (GoString ×
    GoString)} {r : Nat} {e : EvModel} : (⌜e.typ = W32 0 ∧ sint.Z e.rev = ↑r⌝ ∗ ∃ v kvv, kvValAt
    e.kv kvv ∗ ⌜kvv.value = v ∧ (e.key, v) ∈ P⌝ ∗ R r e.key v) ⊢ etcdstart.evFactR R P r e

theorem etcdstart.evFactR_elim {R : Nat → GoString → GoString → IProp GF} {P : List (GoString ×
    GoString)} {r : Nat} {e : EvModel} : etcdstart.evFactR R P r e ⊢ ⌜e.typ = W32 0 ∧ sint.Z e.rev =
    ↑r⌝ ∗ ∃ v kvv, kvValAt e.kv kvv ∗ ⌜kvv.value = v ∧ (e.key, v) ∈ P⌝ ∗ R r e.key v
